sql: SELECT "Apartments"."building_id" AS e, AVG("Apartments"."room_count") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Apartments"."bedroom_count" - "Apartments"."bathroom_count") AS REAL) / "Apartments"."bathroom_count")) AS m2 FROM "Apartments" GROUP BY "Apartments"."building_id" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Apartments.relative difference of number of bedrooms from number of bathrooms
why: average of number of rooms per Apartment_Buildings (by building_id)
(number of bedrooms - number of bathrooms) / number of bathrooms: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of number of bedrooms from number of bathrooms per Apartment_Buildings (by building_id)

sql: SELECT "Apartments"."building_id" AS e, "Apartment_Buildings"."building_description" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Apartments"."bedroom_count" - "Apartments"."bathroom_count") AS REAL) / "Apartments"."bathroom_count")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Apartments" JOIN "Apartment_Buildings" ON "Apartment_Buildings"."building_id" = "Apartments"."building_id"  GROUP BY "Apartments"."building_id", "Apartment_Buildings"."building_description" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
